out-quint.feel: Snappy start, very soft landing. Confident.
out-quint.use: Entrances, hover lifts, modal opens, anything 'arriving'.

in-out-cubic.use: Layout shifts, accordion expand/collapse, height/width transitions.

spring.feel: Subtle overshoot, bouncy but not gummy.
spring.use: Position changes, drag-snap, success confirmations, toggle switches.

ease-out.use: Default for hover state, button press, micro-interactions.

ease-in-out.use: Default for any transition that doesn't fit one of the others. Safe fallback.

instant.use: Reduced-motion fallback. Snap to end state.

fast.use: Hover, focus, color shifts, opacity-only changes.

default.use: Most micro-interactions: button press, dropdown open, toast in.

medium.use: Layout shifts, height/width transitions, modal open, page sheet.

slow.use: Hero entrances, staggered list reveals, route transitions.

reduced_motion_policy: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, force duration to 0 and disable spring/overshoot. Crossfades (opacity-only) MAY remain at fast (150ms) since they don't induce vestibular discomfort.
